quest.title: The Infamous Merc Captain
quest.description: Jahoda reminds you that the person you're about to meet on the giant ship is an infamous merc captain who sails the high seas. You had best act with caution...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.num: Where Waves Meet the Reef: Part I
chapter.title: A Commission From the Curatorium of Secrets

talks.objective: Head to the giant ship on the sea

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, is this...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Alcor?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Actually, this is the second ship in our fleet. The Alcor's back home, patrolling Guyun Stone Forest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Beidou! The infamous merc captain who sails the high seas!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Uh, yeah, haha. We've met, remember? What's with all the pomp and circumstance?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Well, no sense standin' around. Take a seat. Tell me all about it. I'll have my men roll out the welcome mat.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ah, I see. So, you know the head honcho of the Curatorium, huh... Your network of connections is somethin' else, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the registration...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right! We need a record of who's participating in the expo and what you're planning to trade.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Well, mark down me and a few crew members as participants — the rest will stay on the ship. As for what we're trading... Take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: A while ago, Ningguang revamped the Guizhong Ballista. The beauty you see here is one of her new and improved models.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: It has insane firepower and comes complete with remote guidance for accurate striking even at long distances. I just know people are gonna be fighting to get their hands on it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you sure you're allowed to sell stuff like this!?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Haha, don't worry. Compared to the model the Millelith's using, this one might as well be an antique.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Nefer wasn't kidding when she said "no restrictions," huh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But, who's gonna buy something like this?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm sure someone will bite. Buyers from all over Teyvat will be in attendance, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Yelan?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry. I was so busy with the cargo, I forgot to mention that Yelan was aboard.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No worries. You here for the expo too, Yelan?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No, I'm just here for work. Captain Beidou was kind enough to lend me a ride. So, no need to register me with the expo.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #Anyway, it's been a while, {NICKNAME}. If you get the chance, be sure to pass along my regards to the head of the Curatorium.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of work?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The... sensitive kind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like our cue to stop asking questions, doesn't it...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One hundred percent.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Well, I'll be off, then. Once I'm done with this, drinks are on me.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: About time! I've been itching to see Nod-Krai from the bottom of a bottle, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, that's it for registration. Follow us, and we'll take you to the venue.

talks.objective: Take Beidou to the event venue

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Beidou directs her crew to unload the cargo and follows you to the venue.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: So, this is the place, huh? Not a bad spot!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: When you've got some time, come help me test the remote guidance on this thing. It's a real thrill — you'll love it.
